messages:
aria: Heads-up — starting a hetero quant bakeoff for stella-13b across FP8 / AWQ / GPTQ / INT8. Aim: measure accuracy deltas + perf under realistic traffic and define canary + surge safety-net rules for hosted/dedicated/private.

kai: timeline? samples?

aria: quick plan: 1) small canary (0.5% traffic) for 24h with golden QA set, 2) medium corridor (5%) for 48h if no regressions, 3) staged ramp to 25% then 100. Private/dedicated get stricter SLO windows.

devin: what are our regression triggers? latency spikes? metric diffs?

aria: primary signals: a) comp-token latency 99p > baseline + 20% AND b) model quality metrics (exact-match/logprob/ROUGE depending on eval) degrade > configured delta OR c) hallucination-rate on safety probes increases by > 1.5x. Any of the above should trigger automatic rollback.

sanjay: suggest adding availability corridor: if error-rate > 0.5% for 15m -> fallback to fp32 variant. Also include token-cost guard (for hosted).

mika: for private, we need a manual approval gate after medium corridor (legal/compliance customers).

aria: agreed. Also we need per-route sample mining: keep 1% of traffic mirrored to full-precision for drift detection.

kai: can we get a concrete config snippet for the canary bot to apply?

aria: putting one together now — here's a minimal example we can use in rollout automation:
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/generate/stella-13b",
  "variants": ["stella-13b-fp32","stella-13b-awq","stella-13b-gptq","stella-13b-int8","stella-13b-fp8"],
  "canary": {"initial_pct": 0.5, "stages": [5,25,100], "stage_window_hours": [24,48,72]},
  "rollback_signals": {"latency_99p_pct": 20, "quality_delta_pct": 2, "hallucination_multiplier": 1.5},
  "fallback": {"on_failure": "stella-13b-fp32", "grace_period_sec": 30}
}
```

devin: lgtm. A couple of notes: 1) quality_delta_pct needs to be metric-specific (exact-match vs BLEU vs safety rate). 2) We should require at least 1000 golden samples per stage to avoid noisy signals.

aria: noted. We'll parameterize the metric mapping in the rollout job.

canary-bot: deploy job queued: bakeoff-stella-13b-awq -> initiating canary 0.5% on hosted region us-west1.

kai: monitoring hooks? dashboards?

aria: will create per-route dashboard: latency, cost-per-token, quality deltas vs mirror, hallucination probes, top-k failure queries. We'll also log example failure traces to S3 for triage.

mika: for dedicated pools we should enforce a lower max_concurrency to avoid long KV-cache warm-up effects when traffic jumps. Also enable immediate prefix-cache priming on stage-up.

sanjay: operational play: if medium corridor hits any rollback signal -> automatic switch to fallback for 100% of new traffic and trigger an incident with severity P2. If it's a safety-only signal (hallucination) -> route only safety-critical customers to fp32 while leaving others on variant with throttled qps.

aria: good call. We'll add a per-customer override map.

devin: one more — sampling for A/B should be seeded per-user to avoid oscillation across requests. Also keep a small persistent cohort (0.1%) pinned to each variant for longer-term drift checks.

aria: will add pinned cohort and seeded sampling.

infra-ci: perf test job started: microbench fp8/awq/gptq/int8 on a100-p4d. ETA ~3h, results posted to the bakeoff artifact store.

canary-bot: canary stage progressed -> 5% stage starting. Keep an eye on quality deltas over next 48h.

kai: thanks. Let's meet 48h after 5% stage to decide hetero rollforward rules. Quick note: include a kill-switch in the console that maps to immediate traffic re-route and disables autoscale on that variant.

aria: agreed — adding UI kill-switch + API endpoint: POST /rollouts/:id/abort -> immediate fallback.

mika: documenting compliance checklist for private customers and required approvals.

aria: ordering cross-team sync: eng-ml / eng-platform / sre / product tomorrow 10am PT to finalize thresholds and playbooks.

sanjay: will bring incident playbook.

aria: closing thread for now — will post config PR + eval baseline CSV when infra-ci finishes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
